input.question: 百云系列 2026 年 3 月的客群年龄段分布（20岁以下、20-30、30-40、40-50、50以上）占比

expected.reference_sql: WITH distribution AS (SELECT CASE WHEN customer_age < 20 THEN '20以下' WHEN customer_age < 30 THEN '20-30' WHEN customer_age < 40 THEN '30-40' WHEN customer_age < 50 THEN '40-50' ELSE '50以上' END AS age_group, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM dws_loan_credit_day WHERE stat_dt BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND product_series = 'BY' AND is_internal = 0 GROUP BY 1) SELECT age_group, customer_count, customer_count::DECIMAL / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS pct FROM distribution ORDER BY age_group;
expected.reference_narrative: 返回 5 个年龄段的客户数量和占比

meta.rationale: 验证 CASE WHEN 分箱 + 窗口函数占比计算

input.question: 马上消金 2026 年 Q1 每个月的查询量同比变化（对比 2025 年同期）

expected.reference_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM stat_dt) AS yr, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM stat_dt) AS mth, COUNT(*) AS query_count FROM dws_loan_credit_day WHERE (stat_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' OR stat_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31') AND product_series = 'MS' AND is_internal = 0 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT a.mth AS month, a.query_count AS current_count, b.query_count AS last_year_count, CASE WHEN b.query_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (a.query_count - b.query_count)::DECIMAL / b.query_count END AS yoy_pct_change FROM monthly a LEFT JOIN monthly b ON a.mth = b.mth AND a.yr = 2026 AND b.yr = 2025 WHERE a.yr = 2026 ORDER BY a.mth;
expected.reference_narrative: 返回 Q1 三个月的当年/去年查询量和同比百分比变化

meta.rationale: 验证跨年同比 + CTE + 除零防护
